points.description: States that the CNN contains a convolutional layer whose kernels/filters convolve over the input image.
points.partial_credit: Half mark for naming a convolutional layer without stating that kernels/filters convolve over the input image.

levels.says: Names a convolutional layer (with or without mentioning kernels) but does not state that kernels/filters convolve over the input image.

points.description: Mentions the other structural layers: an activation layer (e.g. ReLU), a pooling layer (max or average pooling), and one or more fully connected layers followed by a softmax layer.
points.partial_credit: Quarter mark for each of the four components named: activation layer, pooling layer, fully connected layer(s), softmax layer.

levels.says: Names only one of: activation layer, pooling layer, fully connected layer(s), or softmax layer.
Names two of: activation layer, pooling layer, fully connected layer(s), or softmax layer.
Names three of: activation layer, pooling layer, fully connected layer(s), or softmax layer.

rubric.notes: Full marks require both the convolutional layer with kernels/filters convolving over the input and the remaining layers: activation/ReLU, pooling, fully connected, and softmax. Part marks are given for naming only some of these components or for naming the convolutional layer without saying kernels convolve over the input. No marks for answers that do not describe CNN layers.
